callees.name: record_opencode_call
callees.signature: record_opencode_call(work_dir, event_id, stage, status, started, ended, command, function_ids, input_files, output_files, exit_code, summary, error, metadata, opencode_log_path, opencode_trace_path)
callees.pre_condition: work_dir is an existing directory containing a trace/ subdirectory. event_id, stage, status, started, ended, and command are non-empty strings. exit_code is an integer. All remaining parameters hold their declared types or None.
callees.post_condition: A structured event record containing all provided fields is atomically appended to the events.jsonl file under <work_dir>/trace/. The written record is self-contained and includes event_id, timestamp, stage, command, exit_code, status, and all optional metadata fields.

callees.name: utc_now_iso
callees.post_condition: Returns the current wall-clock time as an ISO 8601 formatted UTC string.
